description: Correct a receipt's top-line amounts when the scan read them wrong: total, subtotal, tax amount, tax rate and tip. Each field is optional: omit it to leave it unchanged, pass null to clear it. At least one field is required. taxRateValue is a percentage (19 for 19%, not 0.19). Only the stored amounts change; a later reparse_receipt re-extracts and overwrites them. Use values the user gave or confirmed. Returns the receipt's amounts after the update.

receiptId.description: Receipt id to update (from list_receipts output).

subtotalValue.description: Subtotal before tax and tip. Omit to leave unchanged; null clears it.

taxAmountValue.description: Tax amount. Omit to leave unchanged; null clears it.

taxRateValue.description: Tax rate as a percentage, 0-100 (19 for 19%). Omit to leave unchanged; null clears it.

tipAmountValue.description: Tip amount. Omit to leave unchanged; null clears it.

totalAmountValue.description: Receipt total. Omit to leave unchanged; null clears it.

name: update_receipt_amounts
